verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's own docs say customers can be screened against Politically Exposed Persons registers, so PEP identification is a direct, documented capability. The evidence pack says nothing about related associates or about the source context attached to PEP hits. missing for 10: documented identification of relatives and close associates, supporting source context and provenance on PEP matches, PEP-specific detail such as classes or tiers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can identify politically exposed persons and related associates with supporting source context

citations.quote: you can check your customers against a global database of Sanctions, Warning, Fitness and Probity and Watchlists, Politically Exposed Persons registers (PEPs) and Adverse Media.
